verdict.rationale: Missive documents assigning conversations to a team or a specific person while keeping visibility. It also documents a rules engine (up to 1000 rules, multi-step rules with delays) that can act on conversations, including reassigning them after 72 hours. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on rule conditions for routing new incoming mail to owners at arrival (e.g., by sender or address), and independent or hands-on corroboration of assignment and routing.

support.subject: As a team-lead, I can assign conversations to teammates and route incoming mail with rules so ownership is explicit

citations.quote: Assign conversations to a team or specific person, while maintaining visibility.
Rules can now run in steps over time. Each step waits, checks its own conditions, then acts on the same conversation.
Escalate unanswered support emails: label at 24 hrs, notify the lead at 48, reassign at 72.
